title: Prose gate as its own plugin
summary: Builds the steward-prose-gate plugin inside this repo, beside the existing steward plugin, which keeps working unchanged. This is the first slice of the split in docs/roadmap/plugin-split.md.
motivation: Steward 0.14.2 is one 1,638-line hook script doing four jobs for four harnesses, so a user cannot take one part, one switch turns off two gates, and personal text ships to everyone (docs/roadmap/plugin-split.md, Why).

included: Shape: one binder. Every outside event (tags, pushes, live installs, merges) is a manual step before or after it; no after edges.

Design steps 2-6 of docs/roadmap/plugin-split.md 'Build sequence', which is the source of truth for every file, contract and done-check: the prose gate hook for Claude Code (2), Copilot (3), Codex (4), the pi extension (5) and packaging (6). One item per step.
Branch: hatch builds from plugin-split after main, carrying manual steps 0 and 1 (tag v0.14.2, pinned catalogs, README notice, tests/test_catalogs.py), is merged into it with --no-ff.

New plugin folder plugins/steward-prose-gate/ with hook, word list, per-harness hook files, pi extension, manifests, tests and README. Outside that folder this binder edits only package.json (scripts.test gains the plugin's unittest and node test runs) and appends one entry to each root marketplace catalog (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .agents/plugins/marketplace.json).

The monolith is NOT modified: hooks/steward_hook.py, codex/steward.py, pi/extensions/steward/, the root manifests and hook files, and every existing test (tests/ and its pi tests) stay untouched. The old gates keep running and keep their tests; the ported cases are copies. No item's touches list names any of these files.

Item check for every item: `PI_SUBAGENTS_DIR=/nonexistent npm test` from the repo root. npm test is package.json scripts.test, at binder start `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && node --test 'tests/pi/*.test.mjs'`, extended per item as the contracts say. node stays the last segment joined by &&, so its final 'fail 0' line prints only when every unittest run before it passed.

Baseline measured at 7d23926 on this machine, 2026-10-24, with PI_SUBAGENTS_DIR=/nonexistent: Python 'Ran 608 tests', 'OK (skipped=13)'; node 'tests 102', 'pass 102', 'fail 0'. Manual step 1 adds tests/test_catalogs.py before the binder starts.

Known baseline: PI_SUBAGENTS_DIR=/nonexistent skips the 13 tests that need an installed pi-subagents. Two of them already fail at c5fd21b on this machine when not skipped, because pi-subagents 0.82.0 is installed and 0.78.0 is mirrored: tests/test_pi_model_plan_apply.py:575 (test_version_is_pinned) and tests/test_pi_model_plan_resolver.py:27 (the mirrored constant; the failing assertion, test_installed_version_is_the_mirrored_one, is at :260). The split does not cause them.
Test totals: an item's printed Python and node totals may grow only by tests it adds; the old tests are not retired here, so no total drops.
Repo rules for every item: one commit per item; never rebase; no agent attribution in commit messages; no em-dashes in shipped texts; Markdown tables use the |-|-| separator.
Runtime: Node 22.18 or newer runs the TypeScript pi extensions without a build step (README.md:419-426); hook scripts are stdlib Python 3.9 or newer (hooks/steward_hook.py:5). No file pins either.
Env: the repo has no environment to start; tests run directly. env_contract.command only reports the two runtimes.
excluded: Later binder: the remaining design steps 7-12, 14 and 16-20 (orchestration, delegation, edicts, retiring the monolith, layout tests, docs). Later steps per the design.
Before this binder, manual step 0: tag v0.14.2 at c5fd21b and push the tag (operator authorizes).

Before this binder, manual step 1: pin the root catalogs' steward entries to v0.14.2 on main with the README notice and tests/test_catalogs.py, plus the live old-install checks on Claude Code and Copilot.

After this binder, manual step 21 (prose-gate parts): live checks on Claude Code, Copilot, Codex and pi, including step 6's scratch-session check (`claude --plugin-dir plugins/steward-prose-gate`) and whether Codex loads a hooks-only manifest, and the full suite without PI_SUBAGENTS_DIR, including the 13 pi-subagents tests.
Merging plugin-split to main with --no-ff is manual and decided later.
Design non-goals relevant here: harness dependency fields; migration code that reads old config paths; a user override for the word list; cross-plugin imports.
Edits to the operator's personal files (~/AGENTS.md, prose-patterns files).

design_facts.stack: Agent-harness plugins for Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Codex CLI and pi: stdlib Python 3.9+ hook scripts, TypeScript pi extensions run by Node 22.18+ type stripping, JSON manifests and Markdown skills; tests are Python unittest and node:test; no third-party dependencies.

work_items.title: Prose gate hook for Claude Code
work_items.summary: Build the prose gate's own hook script and word list file for Claude Code, beside the old script, with its tests.

contract.design: docs/roadmap/plugin-split.md: Build sequence step 2; steward-prose-gate; Hook split (Map of hooks/steward_hook.py, P rows); Word list; Config, state and env vars; Tests.
does: Create plugins/steward-prose-gate/hooks/prose_gate_hook.py: stdlib Python 3.9+, called as `prose_gate_hook.py <harness> <mode>`. This item implements harness `claude` with modes `pr-gate` and `prose-gate`. An unknown harness or mode exits 0 with no output (fail open).

Copy from hooks/steward_hook.py per the map's P rows: get_config_dir (42-61, claude branch: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude), get_state_dir (64-70, dir name steward-prose-gate), get_plugin_root (82-88, used to find data/ai-tells.txt), _expand_user and _non_empty_str (91-104), _compile_marker (1033-1038) compiled from the data file at load, operator patterns with find_operator_hits and find_markers (1044-1089), the PR gate (1092-1153) without the em-dash branch and PR_EMDASH_MSG, cmd_pr_gate = the agent_id skip (1161-1162) plus the switch plus lines 1184-1197, _clean_text (1253-1278), the transcript tail and _extract_last_assistant_text (1281-1361), PROSE_OPERATOR_MSG_TEMPLATE and cmd_prose_gate (1494-1549) without the em-dash count, and its own _dispatch and main.

Create plugins/steward-prose-gate/data/ai-tells.txt: UTF-8, one literal marker per line (not a regex), lines starting with # and blank lines skipped, whitespace trimmed. Content is the 30 entries of MARKERS (hooks/steward_hook.py:1019-1030) in order. A missing or unreadable file means no markers (fail open). Matching stays as _compile_marker does it; the gate blocks on two or more distinct markers or any operator pattern.

Switch: <config>/steward-prose-gate/gate holding on or off, read on every call; when the file is absent, env STEWARD_PROSE_GATE (on|off); default on. One switch covers both gates; there is no soft value.

Operator patterns file: <config>/steward-prose-gate/prose-patterns, format unchanged (one case-insensitive regex per line, # comments, ^ and $ per line, a bad line skipped, one hit blocks). No default file ships.
Kept behavior: a payload agent_id returns early; stop_hook_active skips the check (one revision per reply). No em-dash rule anywhere.
No import of, and no path into, another plugin folder or the old hooks/steward_hook.py; no file under plugins/steward-prose-gate names steward_hook.
package.json scripts.test appends ` && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugins/steward-prose-gate/tests` before the node segment; node stays the last segment, joined by &&.
tests: plugins/steward-prose-gate/tests/helpers.py: a copy of StewardTestCase and run_hook (tests/test_steward_hook.py:41-120) that runs prose_gate_hook.py with the harness as first argument.

plugins/steward-prose-gate/tests/test_prose_gate_claude.py ports PrGateTests (:702), ProseGateTests (:815), MarkerRegexTests (:1011) and OperatorPatternTests (:1136) to `prose_gate_hook.py claude <mode>`, drops their em-dash cases, and adds: an em-dash alone does not block (reply and PR body); the shipped ai-tells.txt parses to exactly the 30 MARKERS entries in order; switch cases (file off, env off, file wins over env, default on); unknown harness and unknown mode exit 0 with no output.
The originals stay in tests/test_steward_hook.py; this binder does not touch them.
contract.red_when: A ported case fails; ai-tells.txt drifts from MARKERS; an em-dash alone still blocks; the discover segment is missing from scripts.test (then the run prints no plugins/steward-prose-gate unittest line, which the totals assertion catches).
contract.repo_rules: One commit for this item; never rebase; no agent attribution in the commit message; no em-dash in shipped text; Markdown tables use the |-|-| separator.

The run prints one more unittest result than before the item (plugins/steward-prose-gate/tests); the root totals are unchanged.

test_prose_gate_claude.py holds the ported PR, prose, marker and operator-pattern cases, an em-dash-alone-passes case for a reply and for a PR body, switch cases, and a word-list case asserting 30 entries equal to MARKERS.
`grep -cvE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' plugins/steward-prose-gate/data/ai-tells.txt` prints 30.
`grep -rniE 'EM_DASH|em.?dash|u2014' plugins/steward-prose-gate/hooks` prints nothing (positive control: the same grep on hooks/steward_hook.py hits lines 29, 1145 and 1530).
`grep -rn steward_hook plugins/steward-prose-gate` prints nothing.

work_items.title: Prose gate on Copilot
work_items.summary: Teach the prose gate script to run under Copilot, including its own record of which session is the main one.

contract.design: Build sequence step 3; steward-prose-gate (New: Copilot SessionStart record); Hook split (Hook entries, map rows 211-229, 242-272, 863-865, 1366-1491).
does: Copilot branch of prose_gate_hook.py. get_config_dir copilot: $COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot.

`copilot session-start` records the main session under <state>/steward-prose-gate/copilot-main/ (copy of hooks/steward_hook.py:211-229 with _sanitize_session_id 863-865) and prints nothing. Without this record the Copilot gates would fail open for every session.
`copilot pr-gate` and `copilot prose-gate` run only for a recorded main session (as at :1167-1168 and :1509-1510); any other session exits 0 with no output, so subagents are not gated.
`copilot prose-gate` reads Copilot events.jsonl (1366-1491), including the task_complete summary and the wait for the file.

Create plugins/steward-prose-gate/copilot/hooks.json: SessionStart (timeout 10), PreToolUse matcher Bash (10), Stop (15); every command is `python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/prose_gate_hook.py" copilot <mode>`, with no VAR=value prefix and no STEWARD_HARNESS.
tests: plugins/steward-prose-gate/tests/test_prose_gate_copilot.py ports the prose-gate parts of tests/test_copilot_harness.py: main-session record and skip, events.jsonl wait, task_complete cases, PR gate; plus a hooks.json case checking events, matchers, timeouts and that every command names prose_gate_hook.py with the copilot argument.
contract.red_when: A session that was never recorded gets gated, or a recorded main session fails open; copilot/hooks.json carries STEWARD_HARNESS or the wrong script.
